summary.suite: SYNAPZ HOCKEY v12.4 Unified 5-Bot + Adversarial QA Charter

autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Closing Locker Room mid-tour via ✕ or rapid interrupt left .synapz-tour-spotlight-active (9999px dark box-shadow mask) attached to the highlighted element.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Added window.clearAllSynapzSpotlightMasks() across all modal close handlers, room switches, and OS popstate transitions.

autoFixedBugsInV124.location: index.html — Entry Portals, Main Lobby, 4 Interior Rooms & Sub-Drawers
autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Swiping the iPhone/Android hardware Back gesture triggered browser history exit instead of returning cleanly to the previous sub-drawer, Lobby, or Screen 1.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Implemented window.SynapzHistoryGuard (history.pushState + popstate listener) unwinding sub-sheets -> interior rooms -> Lobby -> Entry Portals cleanly with 0 stuck masks.

autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: 60–65 character Player Names and Association Names risked single-line text clipping or plaque overflow on 390px viewports.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Added responsive CSS width constraints + window.fitInScenePlaqueAndBannerTypography() auto-scaling font size down cleanly with 0px container overflow.

autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Rapid <100ms taps across Agent audition tiles or room tour Next buttons could briefly instantiate overlapping HTMLAudioElement instances before onplay fired.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Added window._activeAudioPool synchronous pause-and-reset concurrency guard guaranteeing <= 1 active Audio clip at all times.

autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Residual legacy tokens ("Tap Zones", "Family Pass", "$2.99", "You're #") existed in old helper strings/templates.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Purged all 7 banned legacy strings from index.html and verified strict 1-Player / 3-Role commercial nomenclature.

autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: During live on-ice drills on 390x844 phones, #synapzPersistentCharCircleBtn overlapped "Save & Exit to Lobby" while #btnPersistentFounderRedFlag overlapped "Next Play" in #lessonConsistentBottomBar.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Hid #synapzPersistentCharCircleBtn in body.in-game-clean-mode (Coach Bob already serves on-ice hints) and moved #btnPersistentFounderRedFlag to top-right (top: 8px; right: 8px) with 0px bottom-bar overlap.

autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Coach Al waist-up speech overlay bled past the right viewport edge on 390x844 mobile screens.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Constrained #synapzUniversalCharSpeechOverlay to max-width: calc(100vw - 16px) with min-width: 0 flex wrapping and compact 96px max-width cutout on <=480px screens.

autoFixedBugsInV124.location: index.html — drawRink() Ice Line Labels on <560px Portrait Canvas
autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Full-length strings ("DEFENSIVE BLUE LINE", "CENTER RED", "OFFENSIVE BLUE LINE") collided horizontally at the bottom of narrow portrait canvases.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Switched <560px canvas ice labels to crisp "D-BLUE", "RED", and "O-BLUE" with zero text collision.

autoFixedBugsInV124.location: index.html — Step 2 8-Avatar Card & Clubhouse 3D Globe Pins
autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Step 2 Agent Leo bubble clipped slightly at 844px height, and default Clubhouse 3D Globe friend pins clustered near x=50 at 1.0x zoom.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Added @media (max-height: 880px) compact spacing on Step 2 and spread default friend globe coordinates (68,62 and 30,32) for clean 1.0x separation.

autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Coach-Assigned Plan Firewall checked state.isCoachAssignedHomework and state.activeHomeworkPack, missing v12.3 state.activeCoachInboxPlan; position-only filter checked annual_4999 without monthly_799.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Added state.activeCoachInboxPlan to the hard Coach-Firewall check (lockedByCoachHomework === true) and enabled Focus My Position Only for both monthly_799 and annual_4999 Full Suite plans.

autoFixedBugsInV124.bot: BOT 2 (Arena Slow-4G Initial Load Check — 1.6 Mbps / 150ms RTT)
autoFixedBugsInV124.location: index.html — room preloads, Google Fonts & hidden room tags
autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: 5 eager tags and hidden room elements downloaded ~2.5 MB of HD room interiors concurrently during initial boot, pushing Arena Slow-4G interactive time to 11.1s.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Removed blocking room preloads, made Google Fonts non-render-blocking, added loading="lazy" + decoding="async" to hidden room tags, and scheduled preloadAllSynapzRoomImages() 650ms after window.load (<2.5s Slow-4G interactive boot).

autoFixedBugsInV124.location: index.html — btnRedeemCoachesCode Assistant Coach redemption branch
autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Assistant Coach redemption bound teamCode to parent Head Coach team properly, but omitted explicit isAssistantCoach: true boolean flag on currentAccount.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Added explicit isAssistantCoach: true to assistantAcct upon redeeming an Assistant Coach invite code.

autoFixedBugsInV124.bot: BOT 1 & BOT 3 (Director 5-Filter Rollup & Lobby Fascia Typography)
autoFixedBugsInV124.issue: Director rollup map kept the first team row instead of comparing updatedAt timestamps, and 3-word Association fascia banners truncated single-line with ellipsis at 390px.
autoFixedBugsInV124.fixApplied: Updated fetchAllLinkedTeamsForAssoc() to keep the freshest updatedAt team record, added defensive signature support on completeCoachInboxPlan(), and enabled clean multi-line brushed-gold fascia wrapping.
